# Scotch

Scotch is a Software Development company. Scotch is an all-in-one operating system designed exclusively for liquor retailers, offering fast POS, real-time inventory, and built-in eCommerce solutions. Scotch employs 58 people and has an annual revenue of $10M, founded in 2024. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, United States, with an office in San Francisco.

## About

From neighborhood stores to destination warehouses, liquor retailers of all sizes have been held back by manual tasks, slow systems and limited business intelligence. So we decided to build something better — smarter software that saves time and improves margins so independent retailers could focus on their customers, not manually managing inventory.

# Scotch & Soda

Scotch & Soda is a Retail Apparel and Fashion company. Scotch & Soda is a company that offers thoughtfully designed apparel, accessories, and denim with premium fabrics and modern style inspired by Amsterdam. Scotch & Soda employs 698 people (-7.3% YoY, -55 people) and has an annual revenue of $365.6M, founded in 1985. Headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with presence in United States and France. Its workforce is distributed across 31 countries (including Netherlands, United States, France, Germany, and South Africa).

## About

Scotch & Soda celebrates the free spirit of Amsterdam. Endlessly optimistic, we’re inspired by the liberal outlook of our home city, and we champion individuality, authenticity and the power of self-expression – an attitude reflected in our designs.

Effortlessly connecting the expected with the unexpected, our men, women and kids’ collections redefine everyday dressing. We mix classic with contemporary, colour with print, and clashing textures to deliver pieces that remain true to the Scotch & Soda aesthetic. Grounded in practicality and finished with surprising details, our feel-good designs are uniquely ours – for you to make your own.

Designing beautiful, feel-good pieces is one thing, but we also imagine a world where we do good, too. One of our top priorities is to run our business with greater sensitivity to our planet by making more responsible, sustainable choices every day in order to reduce our environmental impact.
